title: Four-fold Fields of Quantum Dreams
description: A very human consideration about taking perspectives on frameworks, told through an adventure playing out in a moment at a Quantum Baseball Spring Training gym.

methods.name: First-person visual-phenomenological reflection on a gym squat rack
methods.description: The essay restricts itself to visually triggered experiences and thoughts while looking at a squat-rack framework during 'Spring Training' in a gym.
methods.evidence: In this document the focus is only on some visually-triggered experiences and thoughts (Blake’s “seeing through the eye”), arising during Spring Training in the gym, as one looks at a framework and allows it to effect/affect them.

methods.name: Successively zoomed photographs of the rack used as the case
methods.description: Photographs of the rack are shown and zoomed in twice on a blurry region to isolate the gap between two vertical structures.
methods.evidence: Arguably, this third image (second zooming-in) conveys the necessary and sufficient information for this situation, if there is some sense that the vertical structure in the foreground and the vertical structure out of focus, are somehow related.

methods.name: Extended baseball metaphor and staged dialog interlude
methods.description: The piece is framed as a Quantum Baseball spring training, with a mock radio ad and an ExecutI'VE/ExecutOR dialog as a '7th inning stretch'.
methods.evidence: A dialog between the ExecutI’VE (the in-principle commissioner of the league) and the ExecutOR (the frontline workers who operate ON and OFF the field).

key_findings: The authors argue that a gap in a framework can either be retained as-is (barrier-like) or filled, enabling different functions.
They argue a trade-off between stability/rigidity and adjustability affordance exists in frameworks, typically settled by the rack's fabricator.
They propose that a framework does not do the work but provides room for work to be done.
They argue blind spots exist from any vantage point and that moving attention, eyes and body removes them.
key_findings_evidence: If left as gap retained, then the function elicited is more “barrier” like (i.e. “Keep Out!”), and if utilized, then function fulfillment can be served through any number of actions
A trade-off between stability/certainty/rigidity and adjustability affordance, simply exists.
A framework doesn’t do the work, as much as provide room for work to be done.
Moving around with attention, eyes, and body, all are “blind spot removers”.

summary_provenance.method: Evidence-grounded extraction from full_text.md: every method and finding carries a verbatim quote from the paper text, mechanically verified to occur in full_text.md (whitespace/ligature-normalized) before merge.
summary_provenance.notes: Speculative/poetic essay rather than a research paper; 'findings' are the authors' interpretive arguments, not empirical results.
